#!/bin/bash

ALL_ADDITIONAL_ARGS=$(env | grep ^JAVA_ADDITIONAL_ | sed 's/^JAVA_ADDITIONAL_[[:alnum:]_]*=//' | tr '\n' ' ')

if [ -n "${ALL_ADDITIONAL_ARGS}" ]; then
    export CATALINA_OPTS="$ALL_ADDITIONAL_ARGS"
    echo "xPlanBox CATALINA_OPTS set -> $CATALINA_OPTS"
fi

exec catalina.sh jpda run
===== Dockerfile =====
ARG XPLANBOX_VERSION=latest
ARG XPLANBOX_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX=xplanbox

ARG IMAGE_PREFIX_DOCKERHUB=docker.io/
FROM ${IMAGE_PREFIX_DOCKERHUB}tomcat:11.0.23-jre25-temurin-noble

ARG BUILD_DATE=?
ARG DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME=?
ARG GIT_REVISION=?
ARG XPLANBOX_VERSION=latest

# see https://github.com/opencontainers/image-spec/blob/main/annotations.md#pre-defined-annotation-keys
LABEL "org.opencontainers.image.created"="$BUILD_DATE" \
	"org.opencontainers.image.description"="ozgxplanung xPlanBox component" \
	"org.opencontainers.image.licenses"="GNU Affero General Public License & others" \
	"org.opencontainers.image.ref.name"="$DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME" \
	"org.opencontainers.image.revision"="$GIT_REVISION" \
	"org.opencontainers.image.title"="ozgxplanung - $DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME" \
	"org.opencontainers.image.url"="https://gitlab.opencode.de/diplanung/ozgxplanung" \
	"org.opencontainers.image.vendor"="lat/lon GmbH" \
	"org.opencontainers.image.version"="$XPLANBOX_VERSION"

USER root

ENV ALLOW_EMPTY_PASSWORD=yes \
    TZ="Europe/Berlin" \
    LC_ALL="en_GB.UTF-8" \
    JMX_EXPORTER_DIR="/xplanbox/prometheus" \
    JAVA_ADDITIONAL_ARG_JMX_EXPORTER='-javaagent:$JMX_EXPORTER_DIR/jmx_prometheus_javaagent-1.0.1.jar=12345:$JMX_EXPORTER_DIR/jmx-exporter.config.yaml'

ADD target/xplan-docker-tomcat-*.tgz /
ADD logging.properties /usr/local/tomcat/conf/
ADD docker-entrypoint.sh /xplanbox/docker-entrypoint.sh

# see https://github.com/adoptium/temurin-build/issues/693
RUN locale-gen en_GB.UTF-8 \
	&& apt-get update && apt-get -y install fontconfig wget \
    && mkdir -p $JMX_EXPORTER_DIR \
    && cp /xplan-docker-tomcat/xplan-docker-resources/jmx-exporter/* $JMX_EXPORTER_DIR \
    && mv /xplan-docker-tomcat/xplan-docker-resources/* /xplanbox

RUN cat /usr/local/tomcat/conf/server.xml | tr '\n' '|' | sed 's|<Valve [^>]*/>||g' | tr '|' '\n' > /tmp/server.xml && mv /tmp/server.xml /usr/local/tomcat/conf/

USER 1001

ENTRYPOINT ["/xplanbox/docker-entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["/xplanbox/docker-entrypoint.sh"]
